card.name: Small joins inside environmental and statistics prose
card.fires_on: Spaces, commas and small linking words in the middle of a list or phrase in environmental, water or census-style prose. Examples are the comma in 'drinking, swimming, and fishing' and the space before a year or percent figure.

modes.label: Commas in lists of water uses
modes.description: A comma or 'and'/'to' between uses of water such as drinking, swimming and fishing.
modes.example: These common sense measures will help protect the water that communities across Florida use for drinking<<,>> swimming, and fishing.

modes.label: Space before a number
modes.description: A bare space just before a percentage or year in statistics text.
modes.example: The bottom<< >>60 percent of households not only failed

modes.label: Linking word in ecosystem or environment phrases
modes.description: A verb or adjective inside a phrase about reefs, carbon or disease burden.
modes.example: which<< include>> productive fishing grounds and the attraction of millions
